description.narrative: On a project level, the Project will benefit stakeholders along the sugar value chain. By improving access to finance for beneficiaries in Vietnams sugar value chain, the Project will enable the Company, distributors, and retailers to sustain operations and employment. At the same time, domestic and regional consumers access to sugar products would be ensured. On a market level, the Project will strengthen the competitiveness of Vietnams agribusiness sector, which is an important driver of the economy. Collateralized warehouse financing is relatively new in Vietnam; this facility will improve the Companys sustainability procurement practices on importing goods, which enables the Company to expand its import capacity. The Project is also expected to have demonstration effects on other agribusiness players that will use similar facilities as well as local commercial banks that replicate this new type of financing.

The proposed IFC investment is a 1-year US$20 million funded participation under a risk-sharing facility of up to US$40 million uncommitted secured revolving trade finance facility with Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation (SMBC or the Bank) for Thanh Thanh Cong - Bien Hoa Joint Stock Company (TTC Sugar or the Company). The facility is renewable annually for additional two years. The facility will be solely dedicated to finance (i) the Companys import of raw sugar; (ii) storage in the approved domestic warehouse(s) with a Collateral Management Agreement (CMA); and (iii) sales to domestic and international customers (collectively, the Project). It will be processed under the Global Warehouse Finance Program (GWFP) with delegated authority from IFCs Board of Directors.
